remarks: Amazing & updated place to call home for a wonderful price. Sleek and sophisticated finishes throughout in this Norwalk condo. Washer/Dryer in unit. This one bedroom offers a bright, light and airy open concept with turn key living. Gorgeous flooring throughout, stainless appliances, freshly painted, finished with stone, marble, quartz and tile accents complete the elevated aesthetics of this sought after home. Conveniently located complex with a well maintained pool & attached garage. Within minutes to shopping, restaurants, train, parks and playgrounds as well major highways. Available November 16th. 700+ credit and good income. You'll love living here!
